doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Dancer: ThiefKit.fires_in_dash reads dash.*.lmb.mode and ThiefKit._empowers reads dash.*.lmb.variant; a move another press starts mid-cartwheel waits out the flip (ThiefKit.play). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source. dash_jump.<ground|air|rise|same>: Space in a ground dash, Space in an air dash, Shift in a jump's rise, both on one step: {ours: cancel | both | ignore | end | buffer | dash (measured, --dash-jump-check), carry: share of the dash's speed kept, source, verdict: match | [?] (the source doesn't settle it)}.

lmb.source: Data: Quickflip dashes and empowers the next Arcslinger (+214 damage); landing it resets Quickflip. Footage 0193: the Cartwheel and the empowered shot leave on the same frame, so the bolt goes mid-flip.

rmb.source: Data says nothing on casting during Quickflip. Footage never shows Trickshot mid-flip; kept firing: the 0.4s lane starts mid-flip and the throw lands after it.

e.source: Data: Farstep Dagger has no dash rule. Footage never shows it mid-flip. Ours: the throw goes mid-flip; the recast blink ends the cartwheel (she arrives standing).

x.source: Data: Fusillade resets Quickflip; footage (0296-0303): she walks and fires freely through it; nothing shows it locked out by a dash.

q.source: Not in the data or footage (gloves are ours); fires like her other actives.

lmb.source: Data: Quickflip is the same from a jump (empowers the next Arcslinger). Footage 0129-0134 air Cartwheel, then the gold empowered aim line at 0139-0142 and the big shot at 0143.

rmb.source: Not shown in the data or footage; same as on the ground.

e.source: Not shown in the data or footage; same as on the ground (the recast blink ends the cartwheel).

x.source: Not shown from the air; same as on the ground.

q.source: Not in the source; same as her other actives.

lmb.source: Footage 0187 -> 0193: the empowered hit lands and the next Cartwheel follows at once; a bolt in flight keeps going.

rmb.source: Not shown in the data or footage. Ours: Shift in the Bola's 0.4s wind-up cartwheels and the Bola still goes at the end of the wind-up.

e.source: Not shown. Ours: the dagger thrown 0.12s into the throw still flies if she cartwheels; a stuck dagger stays to blink to.

x.source: Footage (0296-0350): she moves and acts freely through Fusillade, which also gives Quickflip back.

q.source: Not in the source; the glove keeps running.

ground.source: Data: no jump-in-dash rule; the jump and air-dash tunables (JumpOffJumpZFactor, AirDashSpeedMultiplier) are C++ defaults still locked (supervive_physics.md:95, :108-109). Footage (Shiv): the one jump is a jump into a Cartwheel (dancer.md:431-440); no Space inside a Cartwheel.

rise.source: Footage 0129-0134 (dancer.md:431-440): she jumps at 303.8 s and cartwheels from 304.0 s, still rising (0130 airborne, 0131 the Cartwheel card up): the flip goes at once off the jump, flat, 'no extra float or hang'.

same.source: Data: no jump-in-dash rule; the jump and air-dash tunables (JumpOffJumpZFactor, AirDashSpeedMultiplier) are C++ defaults still locked (supervive_physics.md:95, :108-109). Footage (Shiv): the one jump is a jump into a Cartwheel (dancer.md:431-440); no Space inside a Cartwheel. The footage is 5 fps (0.2 s a frame, PHYSICS_PARITY.md:170): one step can't be seen.
